svg.title: What changes in neutralisation, and which ions remain?
svg.desc: H₃O⁺ and OH⁻ form two H₂O. Na⁺ and Cl⁻ are present before and after: cancelling them in the equation does not remove dissolved salt.
svg.text: 63 · What changes in neutralisation, and which ions remain?
Teaching schematic · supplied data · not an experiment procedure
H₃O⁺ and OH⁻ form two H₂O. Na⁺ and Cl⁻ are present before and after: cancelling them in the
equation does not remove dissolved salt.
